summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K furnished with a press release dated August 5, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial and operational results. The release covers production of 97,429 ounces of gold, AISC of $2,192 per ounce, net earnings of $37.2 million, adjusted EBITDA of $166.9 million, and a cash position of $192.2 million. It also references an already-announced $295 million strategic investment by Zijin Gold, but that transaction is not the subject of this filing. This is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural transaction details are provided herein.
